text: Gomɗii debbo on himmirii waɗugol faahisaaku ngun. Ɗum kadi ari e miijo oya si wanaano o yi'ii e Aayeeje Alla ɗen ko haɗata mo e ɗum woɗɗina mo e mun. Men hollirii mo ɗe fii no Men yiltira mo e bone, Men woɗɗindina mo e jeeno e jenfa. Pellet Yuusufa ko jeyaaɗo e jeyaaɓe amen suɓiraaɓe Nulal e Annabaaku.
